name: Flipper Zero Dev Board Pro
one_line: ESP32-based Flipper Zero GPIO peripheral pre-flashed with ESP32 Marauder for WiFi capability, sold explicitly as JCMK's own alternative to the official Flipper Zero WiFi Dev Board.
why_notable: Variant, not a new device: JCMK markets this by name as an alternative to the 'official Flipper Zero WiFi Dev Board' already in the DB. Differs in: header pins mounted on the underside of the PCB (sits flush against the Flipper body vs the official board's top-mounted pins), a built-in microSD slot (no soldering needed for PCAP saving), firmware pre-flashed out of the box, and a 3D-printed enclosure included.

has_gps: no onboard GPS (sold separately, see GPS Expansion entries)
has_battery: none onboard, powered via Flipper Zero GPIO
has_ext_antenna: not specified/none called out (compact PCB antenna implied)

dupe_of: nRF24L01+ module for Flipper Zero (mousejack / 2.4 GHz)

has_battery: no, powered via Flipper Zero SPI header
